name: Far-end posterior 3R (fold-free posterior J1 line, hubs at either end of their axis lines, raglan-routed links)
verdict: killed after the coarse sweep: best honest 118.55 (best overall 98.03, links parked at 400 mm) vs the plain 3R control 51.33; the fold-free posterior layout sends link rays through the neck / chest in 10-20 % of closing poses and every far-end hub choice is worse than the near end
limiter: links through the body (raglan map: inf share 0.1-0.2 at almost every link cell); hub 2 and hub 3 0 % in band; far ends of GH lines lie in torso / axilla / neck
note: 256 configs on the farm (4 posterior layouts x branch x 8 end choices x route d 0/25 x q .9/.97); best honest {'az': -24.0, 'el': 4.0, 'a1': 65.0, 'a2': 85.0, 'wd': 60.0, 'wa': -78.0, 'sigma': 1, 'e1': 1, 'e2': 1, 'e3': 1, 'r1t': 0.5, 'r1d': 0.0, 'r2t': 0.5, 'r2d': 0.0, 'q': 0.9}; best overall 98.03 {'az': -24.0, 'el': 4.0, 'a1': 65.0, 'a2': 85.0, 'wd': 60.0, 'wa': -78.0, 'sigma': 1, 'e1': 1, 'e2': 1, 'e3': 1, 'r1t': 0.5, 'r1d': 25.0, 'r2t': 0.5, 'r2d': 25.0, 'q': 0.97}; 7 of 256 honest; parent's independent _template sweep of the same layouts agrees (best 73.01 at a vertical J1 line, horizontal posterior lines 92.7-98.1)

mechanism.notes: plain spherical 3R on the fold-free posterior J1 line (raglan-routed-3r builder; hub of each axis at either end of its line - same parts either way). bodies: link 1, link 2, arm-end (member 3: hub-3 plate + K7 neck rigid on BOTTOM); joints: J1, J2, J3 O20 hubs (MR117-2RS pair each). Bench has no GH translation: no cuff slide modelled (the user's cuff slides / liner take GH slip, outside the count; if counted, +2 passive_trans, crossed). custom: base, 2 links, arm-end plate + neck, 3 hub shafts (est.); catalogue: 3 x MR117 pair (est., fasteners excluded).
